Declared assembly and pressure

    A pressure or compatibility violation blocks this experiment. Missing evidence allows geometry inspection only. Passing these declared checks does not certify survival or determine minimum operating pressure; inflation does not change the existing radial surrogate's stiffness.

    Read Schwalbe's scoped hookless guidance

    Nominal width-specific service recommendations apply only to the declared Schwalbe hookless family. Component maxima still apply. These are not burst pressures.

    Blowout and breakage coverage

    MechanismCurrent disposition

    Rim contact is a geometric event. It does not automatically mean fracture or a puncture. Suspension bottom-out likewise need not break a wheel. Supported future damage must change load paths, pressure/contact behaviour and energy accounting; an unsupported post-failure state must stop.

    Edit profile, component declarations and provenance

    Complete experiment inputs in SI: params, ordered profile, assembly and displacement delta. The assembly accepts field-level source records. Exact product limits and approvals must be supplied; null means unknown. Imported results are recomputed.
